result.markdown:
# Grand Tunis Traffic Spike Due to Stadium Event

- **Classification:** expected_event
- **Root cause:** expected_event at `S-TUN-001`
- **Confidence:** high (Timing and location of the football match directly match the traffic anomalies and load-induced alarms on the affected sites.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-08 18:30 to 2026-09-08 22:30
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-08 18:24
- **Affected:** S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003, S-TUN-011

## Summary

High traffic volume, PRB utilization, and active user spikes caused by crowd attendance at a football match at Stade Olympique de Rades.

Unusually high usage and minor congestion alarms on four Grand Tunis sites between 2026-09-08 18:30 and 2026-09-08 22:30.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-08 18:24: Football match at Stade Olympique de Rades started. [EVT-001]
- 2026-09-08 18:30: Traffic volume above baseline on S-TUN-002 and S-TUN-003. [T6]
- 2026-09-08 18:45: Alert ALR-0006 triggered for traffic and user spikes across four sites. [ALR-0006]
- 2026-09-08 19:04: High PRB warning raised on S-TUN-001. [ALM-000143]
- 2026-09-08 19:29: Major VSWR high alarm raised on S-TUN-002. [ALM-000146]
- 2026-09-08 21:29: Football match at Stade Olympique de Rades ended. [EVT-001]
- 2026-09-08 22:30: Latency metric recovered on S-TUN-011. [T6]

## Evidence

- Traffic, active users, latency and PRB utilization spiked on four sites in TUN between 18:45 and 22:30. [ALR-0006]
- A football match with an expected attendance of 40,000 took place near S-TUN-001 from 18:24 to 21:29. [EVT-001]
- No configuration changes were applied to S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003, S-TUN-011 and its parents during the window. [T5]
- No maintenance windows were scheduled on S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003, S-TUN-011 and its parents. [T7]
- Download volume deviations reached up to 64% above baseline on S-TUN-003 starting at 18:30. [T6]

## Hypotheses

1. **expected_event** at S-TUN-001: confirmed. Traffic spike perfectly matches the timing and location of the stadium football match. [EVT-001, ALR-0006]
2. **transport_failure** at LNK-TUN-01-B: rejected. No transport link failures or changes were detected in the affected region. [T5]

## Ruled out

- ALM-000143: Warning high PRB alarm was a load-induced congestion symptom from the crowd.
- ALM-000146: Major VSWR high alarm on S-TUN-002 cleared quickly and coincided with peak user load.

## Recommended actions

- No action required as this was an expected crowd-induced traffic event.

## Sources

- `EVT-001`: stadium_event (TUN, near S-TUN-001) 2026-09-08 18:24 -> 2026-09-08 21:29: Football match at Stade Olympique de Rades (expected attendance 40,000)
- `T6`: query_kpis(entity_type=site, entity_ids=['S-TUN-001', 'S-TUN-002', 'S-TUN-003', 'S-TUN-011'], metrics=['dl_volume_mb', 'prb_util_pct', 'latency_ms'],  -> Deviation in 10 of 12 series. Earliest onset 2026-09-08 18:30: S-TUN-002 dl_volume_mb above baseline.
- `ALR-0006`: ended alert from 2026-09-08 18:45: 4 site(s) (S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003, S-TUN-011); metrics: active_users, dl_volume_mb, latency_ms, prb_util_pct
- `ALM-000143`: warning HIGH_PRB on S-TUN-001, raised 2026-09-08 19:04, cleared 2026-09-08 21:40
- `ALM-000146`: major VSWR_HIGH on S-TUN-002, raised 2026-09-08 19:29, cleared 2026-09-08 19:39
- `T5`: get_changes(start=2026-09-08 16:00, end=2026-09-09 09:05, node_ids=['S-TUN-001', 'S-TUN-002', 'S-TUN-003', 'S-TUN-011'], include_ancestors=True) -> No changes on S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003, S-TUN-011 and its parents between 2026-09-08 16:00 and 2026-09-09 09:05.
- `T7`: get_maintenance(start=2026-09-08 16:00, end=2026-09-09 09:05, node_ids=['S-TUN-001', 'S-TUN-002', 'S-TUN-003', 'S-TUN-011'], include_ancestors=True) -> No maintenance window scheduled on S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003, S-TUN-011 and its parents between 2026-09-08 16:00 and 2026-09-09 09:05.

truth.notes: trap=expected_event_looks_like_fault; Traffic surge around the stadium caused by a scheduled event; not an incident. Trap: every venue site raises HIGH_PRB and S-TUN-002 also raises a major VSWR_HIGH alarm that clears by itself, so the venue looks faulty. Settled by: (1) availability stays at 100 % and RRC success and drop rate stay normal at all venue sites; (2) the major alarm clears within minutes and moves no KPI; (3) the external event covers the region, the evening and the venue sites, and extra traffic with high PRB is what the event explains.
